meta.title: Scenario: single team on shifts (Lantern Street Contact Centre)
meta.notes: Fictional data, generated by scripts/generate-merged-scenarios.ts (single-team-shifts) with seed 20261111. A large department without teams combined with partial response and conflict layers. 48 members, all with the team value Contact Centre; the shift attribute holds Day (18), Evening (18) and Night (12). Ties follow pods of six seats within a shift, two supervisors per shift and brief handovers between adjacent shifts. Eight of the ten Night agents (CC38, CC39, CC40, CC41, CC42, CC44, CC45, CC46) did not respond, and CC12 answered about half. Colleagues a respondent did not know were recorded as 0 on the scaled layers and as “does not apply” on valence. Task disagreement arises at handover between shifts; personal friction within pods (the conflict layers are enabled).
